- **He's on your bench**, so Fix now has nothing to fix for him. Your starting RBs are Cook, Brown, Javonte Williams and Gordon. He has a Sleeper projection of 0.0 this week and 10.2 points a game rest of season. ESPN experts don't rank him this week and had him at RB20 lately.

**What to do:** Leave him on the bench. Look at Friday's injury report: if he's cleared and Marks is ruled out, he's worth starting over Gordon (the RB13 in ESPN experts' ranks). Otherwise, no change.
